(declare-sort Witness 0)
(declare-fun child_truth (Witness) Int)
(declare-fun native_type (Witness) Int)
(declare-fun logical_type (Witness) Int)
(declare-fun present (Witness) Bool)
(declare-fun selected_type () Int)
(assert (forall ((w Witness)) (and (>= (child_truth w) 0) (<= (child_truth w) 2))))
(assert (forall ((w Witness)) (=> (present w) (= (logical_type w) (native_type w)))))
(assert (let ((a!1 (exists ((w Witness))
             (and (present w)
                  (= (logical_type w) selected_type)
                  (= (child_truth w) 1))))
      (a!2 (exists ((w Witness))
             (and (present w)
                  (= (logical_type w) selected_type)
                  (= (child_truth w) 2))))
      (a!3 (exists ((w Witness))
             (and (present w)
                  (= (native_type w) selected_type)
                  (= (child_truth w) 1))))
      (a!4 (exists ((w Witness))
             (and (present w)
                  (= (native_type w) selected_type)
                  (= (child_truth w) 2)))))
  (distinct (ite a!1 1 (ite a!2 2 0)) (ite a!3 1 (ite a!4 2 0)))))
